name: aaf
description: Agent Accessibility Framework — making websites reliably operable by browser agents via semantic DOM annotations and typed capability manifests.
author: Alejandro Gonzalez

scripts.build:extension-demo: npx vite build --config extension_demo/vite.config.ts --mode popup && npx vite build --config extension_demo/vite.config.ts --mode content-script
scripts.dev:extension-demo: sh -c 'npx vite build --watch --config extension_demo/vite.config.ts --mode popup & npx vite build --watch --config extension_demo/vite.config.ts --mode content-script & wait'
